title: fix(service-analytics): the ObjectQL strategy serves $icontains; a valid comparand no longer answers an uncoded 500 (#20098)
body:
Fixes #20098

Clause-②: no

## What this changes

`ObjectQLStrategy.convertFilter` (`packages/services/service-analytics/src/strategies/objectql-strategy.ts`) translates each normalized filter leaf into the `FilterCondition` operand the engine expects. The normalizer emits an `icontains` leaf for `$icontains`, and for the `FilterArray` `icontains`, which `parseFilterAST` lowers to `$icontains` first. `convertFilter` had no arm for that leaf, so every `$icontains` fell to its catch-all and threw a bare `Error` with no `code` and no `status`. That included a valid `'acme'`.

The new arm is one line in the shape the four sibling text arms use:

```ts
case 'icontains': return { $icontains: String(v0) };
```

- It passes the canonical spec operator through. `FILTER_OPERATORS` declares `$icontains`, and `StringOperatorSchema` types it `z.string()`.
- The ASCII-only fold (#4706 Q1 = A) stays with the engine and the driver, as on every other face. ⛔ No local fold, no `$regex` (#5557 is the precedent), and no second implementation of the text semantics.
- PR #20096's comparand refusals still come first and are unchanged. The `where` door refuses an empty or non-string `$icontains` before a leaf exists, so `String(…)` is an identity on everything that can reach this arm. Ablation D below measures what that ordering protects.
- The same arm serves the other two callers of `filterNodeToCondition`: a compiled dataset's scope and a measure filter.
- The catch-all throw is untouched. It stays loud for an operator the normalizer never emits.

## Measured first (recorded on this branch as `75a7c920aa`, before any source change)

Base `origin/main` `7c1039b388`. The fixture is a real `ObjectQL` engine over a real `SqliteWasmDriver` (sql.js). Rows (field `name`): a1 'Acme Corp', a2 'ACME ltd', a3 'beta', a4 NULL, a5 '', a6 'CAFÉ', a7 'café'. The echo's SQL was run on the same database. The throwaway harnesses were not committed.

**In process (the `where` door, caller-authored):**

| cell | `engine.find` direct | `ObjectQLStrategy.execute` | `AnalyticsService.query` (ObjectQL) | native execute | echo (run) | `AnalyticsService.query` (native) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `$icontains: 'acme'` | a1 a2 | bare `Error`, `code` undefined, `status` undefined: "[analytics] ObjectQL strategy cannot express filter operator "icontains"" | same bare `Error` | a1 a2 | a1 a2 | a1 a2 |
| `$icontains: 'ACME'` | a1 a2 | bare `Error` | bare `Error` | a1 a2 | a1 a2 | a1 a2 |
| `$icontains: 'CAFÉ'` (ASCII-only fold) | a6 | bare `Error` | bare `Error` | a6 | a6 | a6 |
| `$icontains: 'café'` | a7 | bare `Error` | bare `Error` | a7 | a7 | a7 |
| `$not` over `$icontains: 'acme'` | a3 a4 a5 a6 a7 | bare `Error` | bare `Error` | a3 a4 a5 a6 a7 | a3 a4 a5 a6 a7 | a3 a4 a5 a6 a7 |
| `FilterArray` `['name','icontains','acme']` | a1 a2 | bare `Error` | bare `Error` | a1 a2 | a1 a2 | a1 a2 |
| `$contains: 'acme'` (case-exact control) | (none) | (none) | (none) | (none) | (none) | (none) |

**The HTTP door, `POST /api/v1/analytics/query`, with an ObjectQL-served datasource.** The card recorded this leg as a code reading. This PR measures it: `packages/runtime`'s real route (`createDispatcherPlugin`, the fake-server shape `analytics-query-read-scope-withhold.test.ts` uses) over a real `AnalyticsService` imported from source, with `objectqlAggregate: true`, `nativeSql: false`, and `executeAggregate` bound to `engine.aggregate`. Read and measured only; `packages/runtime` is not edited.

| cell | status | `body.error` | `engine.aggregate` calls |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `$icontains: 'acme'` | **500** | `INTERNAL_ERROR`, message "[analytics] ObjectQL strategy cannot express filter operator "icontains". Treating it as an equality …" relayed | 0 |
| `$icontains: 'CAFÉ'` | 500 | same | 0 |
| `$not` over `$icontains: 'acme'` | 500 | same | 0 |
| `FilterArray` `['name','icontains','acme']` | 400 | `VALIDATION_FAILED`, `where`: expected record, received array (the door is object-only) | 0 |
| `$icontains: ''` (the #20068 refusal) | 400 | `VALIDATION_FAILED` at `where.name.$icontains`, the spec's reason | 0 |
| `$contains: 'cme'` (control) | 200 | rows a1 | 1 |

**`convertFilter`'s input vocabulary against its arms.** Each `FILTER_OPERATORS` spelling was sent through `normalizeAnalyticsFilterTree`, then the ObjectQL strategy, the engine and the native face:

| spelling | leaf operator(s) the normalizer emits | `engine.find` | ObjectQL execute | native | verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `$eq` | `equals` | a3 | a3 | a3 | covered |
| `$ne` | `notSet`, `notEquals` | a1 a2 a4 a5 a6 a7 | same | same | covered |
| `$gt` / `$gte` / `$lt` / `$lte` | `gt` / `gte` / `lt` / `lte` | equal on all three faces | = | = | covered |
| `$in` / `$nin` | `in` / `notSet`, `notIn` | equal on all three | = | = | covered |
| `$between` | `gte`, `lte` | a2 a5 a6 | same | same | covered |
| `$contains` / `$notContains` / `$startsWith` / `$endsWith` | same-named leaves | equal on all three | = | = | covered |
| `$icontains` | `icontains` | a1 a2 | **bare `Error`** | a1 a2 | **missing: fixed here** |
| `$null` / `$exists` | `notSet` / `set` | a4 | a4 | a4 | covered |
| `$like` / `$ilike` (staged, not in `FILTER_OPERATORS`) | refused at the door, `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 | a1 a2 (the engine answers) | refused at the door | refused at the door | intentionally refused: the spec's staging table names `service-analytics` a REFUSING face |
| `$regex` (retired) | refused at the door, `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 | refused, `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 | refused at the door | refused at the door | intentionally refused |

`icontains` is the only operator the normalizer emits that `convertFilter` has no arm for. No other operator is missing, so this PR does not widen.

## After (head `109691058d`, `origin/main` `6780e34af5` merged in)

- In process, every cell above answers on every face, and each face answers the rows `engine.find` answers. `'acme'` / `'ACME'` give a1 a2. `'CAFÉ'` gives a6 only and `'café'` gives a7 only. `$not` gives a3 a4 a5 a6 a7. The `FilterArray` gives a1 a2.
- HTTP re-measure: `$icontains: 'acme'` is **200, rows a1 a2**, with 1 engine call. `'CAFÉ'` is 200, a6. `$not` is 200, a3 a4 a5 a6 a7. The `FilterArray` and `''` rows are unchanged: 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` at the door parse.
- The engine receives `{ name: { $icontains: 'acme' } }` for `'acme'` (the comparand verbatim, whatever its case), and nothing else.

## Tests

New file `packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/objectql-icontains-arm.test.ts`, 27 cases, over a real `ObjectQL` + `SqliteWasmDriver`:

- Six cells: `'acme'`, `'ACME'`, `'CAFÉ'`, `'café'`, `$not` and the `FilterArray` spelling. Each takes its reference from `engine.find` first, then asserts the same row ids on `ObjectQLStrategy.execute`, `AnalyticsService.query` (ObjectQL), native execute and `AnalyticsService.query` (native).
- The engine receives the canonical `$icontains` with the comparand verbatim (`'acme'`, `'ACME'`, `'CAFÉ'`).
- A dataset scope and a measure filter reach the same arm, with the native face as the control.
- Every `FILTER_OPERATORS` spelling: a completeness assertion over the sample table, then per spelling the engine's rows (non-trivial) on the ObjectQL and native faces, with every `$` key the engine received drawn from the declared vocabulary.
- The catch-all CONTROL, through the private translator: an operator the normalizer never emits still throws, naming it. Every leaf operator the normalizer emits for the declared vocabulary translates without a throw.

`icontains-text-comparand-refusal.test.ts` (PR #20096): its `CONTROL` case had excluded the ObjectQL faces from the `'acme'` row "while `convertFilter` had no `icontains` arm". It now runs every face. **Every refusal case in that file is unchanged and green.**

At head `109691058d`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: **128 files, 3017 tests passed**.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics run typecheck`: exit 0. `tsc --noEmit --listFiles` includes all three touched `.ts` files.

### Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, WRAP mode, anchor hit x1, all at head `109691058d`)

The tests import the subject by relative `src` path, and `@objectstack/objectql` is aliased to `src` in this package's vitest config, so no `dist` is in the path.

| leg | mutation | red / green (two files, 71 cases, unless noted) | restore |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| A (reverse verification) | the `icontains` arm removed | **11 red** / 60 green: all six cells, the verbatim pin, dataset scope + measure filter, the `$icontains` vocabulary row, the emitted-leaf translation case, and PR #20096's widened control. Its refusal cases stay green: the door refuses before the arm | blob `91aacf6cf586` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty |
| B (local fold) | `String(v0).toLowerCase()` in the arm | **2 red** / 69 green: `'CAFÉ'` answered **a7 instead of a6** on the ObjectQL face, and the verbatim pin. `'acme'` / `'ACME'` / `'café'` stay green, as predicted: only the non-ASCII upper-case row shows a local fold | blob == HEAD |
| C (catch-all) | `default:` returns `v0`, the equality #4128 removed | **1 red** / 26 green (new file only): the catch-all CONTROL | blob == HEAD |
| D (door first) | #20068's `where`-door refusal disabled (`filter-normalizer.ts`) | **6 red** / 38 skipped (PR #20096's file, `-t ObjectQL`): on both ObjectQL faces, `$icontains: 42` was **answered `[]`**, laundered to `'42'` by the arm's `String(…)`. `''` and `$not` over `''` reached the engine (1 call instead of 0). This measures why the refusal must stay first | blob `a7bdec971782` == HEAD |
| E (folded onto the case-exact sibling) | the arm returns `$contains` | **8 red** / 63 green: `'acme'`, `'ACME'`, `$not`, `FilterArray`, the verbatim pin, dataset scope + measure filter, the `$icontains` vocabulary row, PR #20096's control. `'CAFÉ'` / `'café'` stay green, as predicted: case-exact and ASCII-folded agree on those two | blob == HEAD |

The first attempt at leg C was a no-op. Its replacement contained the anchor text, so the tool refused (`anchor count moved 1 -> 1`), restored, and ran no test. It was re-run with a non-overlapping replacement, which is the reading above.

## Gates (head `109691058d`)

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` derived 60 families from the real diff (4 paths, +383 / -12). That is 6 more than the dispatch-time list: `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:objectql-double-limit`, `check:query-options-erasure`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:type-check-debt`, `check:where-matcher`. `--ran` reconciliation: **60 derived, 60 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN** (a derived zero: every line carries its exit code).

- All 60 families: exit 0. Among them: `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` ("this PR adds no declared-breaking changeset"), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs` and `check:test-source-alias`. `check:type-check-debt` re-measured 4 ledger entries with none above its number. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` passed: 105 published require entry points across 67 packages load.
- On the previous head (`08dd00660f`, before `origin/main` moved again), the same 60 were run. Two refused their prerequisite (exit 3) until their closure was built: `check:type-check-debt` then gave exit 0, and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` stayed NOT MEASURED there. Both are measured green at this head.
- `GITHUB_TOKEN=… node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs`: exit 0, 8 citations, all resolve. The `--census` spelling takes a workflow value and is NOT MEASURED locally.
- Lint, narrowed and proven: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 3 changed `.ts` files gave 3 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. `isPathIgnored` answers false for each. `eslint.config.mjs` never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move the verdict of any untouched file.
- The rebuilt `service-analytics/dist/index.js` and `index.cjs` each carry `return { $icontains: String(v0) }` once, and `index.cjs` loads under `require` (17 exports).

## Acceptance notes

- **`String(…)` and the ordering it relies on.** The arm follows its four siblings' `String(…)`. Today that is an identity, because the door refuses every empty or non-string `$icontains` first. Ablation D shows the cost if that door ever regressed: on this face, `42` would be laundered to `'42'` and answered with no row. Passed unconverted, `driver-sql`'s own refusal would have been a second net. PR #20096's pins go red either way, so the door's absence cannot land silently. The sibling shape was kept, as the dispatch specified.
- **The `FilterArray` spelling reaches this face in process only.** `POST /analytics/query` types `where` as an object and refuses an array whole (400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`, measured above). The spelling reaches `ObjectQLStrategy` through direct `AnalyticsService.query` callers, and its row pin here covers that.
- **The catch-all still throws a bare `Error`.** After this PR, no operator the normalizer emits reaches it; the vocabulary block pins that. An arrival would mean the two tables drifted again, which is a server fault by construction, so the uncoded 500 stays as it was.
- The fixture adds two rows (a6 'CAFÉ', a7 'café') to #20068's five. The pair differs only in the case of a letter the fold must not touch, which is what makes the ASCII-only boundary observable.

## Out-of-scope findings

None. The vocabulary enumeration above found no other operator that `convertFilter` lacks and the engine accepts. `$like` / `$ilike` / `$regex` are refused at the door on purpose.
